en.t: The young lady played for a little while.

units.source_text: 琴声很悦耳，但也并无特别高明之处。

en.t: The sound of the qin was very pleasing to the ear, but there was nothing especially skillful about it.

units.source_text: 原来七弦琴音色甚好，与别种乐器不同，所以源氏公子并不觉得难听。

en.t: As it happened, the seven-stringed qin had a very fine tone, unlike other instruments, so Prince Genji did not find it unpleasant to hear.

units.source_text: 他心中有种种感想：“在这荒芜岑寂的所在，当年常陆亲王曾经遵照古风，尽心竭力地教养这小姐，

en.t: Many thoughts came into his mind: "In this desolate and silent place, long ago Prince Hitachi followed the old ways and devoted himself completely to raising this young lady,

units.source_text: 可是现在已经影迹不留，这小姐住在这里好生凄凉啊！

en.t: but now not a trace of that remains, and how lonely it is for this young lady to live here!

units.source_text: 古代小说中所描写的凄惨情景，正是发生在这种地方的吧！”

en.t: The wretched scenes described in old tales must be just the sort of things that happen in places like this!"

units.source_text: 他想向这小姐求爱，又觉得太唐突，难以为情，心中踌躇不决。

en.t: He wanted to court the young lady, but felt it would be too abrupt and embarrassing, and he hesitated uncertainly in his heart.
